trials.name: base-504
trials.label: Couch · Base

floor.source: semantic floor pixels + RANSAC; no IMU gravity

diagnostics.method: Mutual SIFT ratio matches, source depth confidence above per-view 40th percentile; predicted poses project source pixels into the next view.
diagnostics.note: Image correspondence consistency only. Repeated textures, moving objects, calibration and occlusion can affect this diagnostic.

walls.evidence: Vertical plane fitted to labelled wall depth; panel interiors are interpolated
Vertical plane fitted to labelled wall depth; panel interiors are interpolated
Vertical plane fitted to labelled wall depth; panel interiors are interpolated
Vertical plane fitted to labelled wall depth; panel interiors are interpolated

envelope.assumption: Rectangle around the middle 96% of visible points. Unseen room extent and wall height are unconstrained; this can cut through the real room.

floor_holdout.note: Views withheld from plane fitting only; shared DA3 inference and semantics, no ground truth.

completion_holdout.note: A projected object can stand above floor. These are ambiguity flags, not physical accuracy or collision labels.

trials.warning: Exploratory layout. All depth and positions are estimates. Completion never establishes free space, unseen people, or measured room dimensions.
